title: Enzo Innocenzi — Software engineer
description: Hey, I am Enzo Innocenzi. I am a software engineer and open-source contributor, currently working as a full-stack web developer.

home.tagline: A software engineer and open-source contributor.
about: I got into programming when I was about 12, and I’ve been doing it professionally since I was 18. My main stack is PHP and TypeScript, usually with {laravel}, {hybridly}, {vue}, and {tailwind}.
I tend to be detail-oriented and a bit of a perfectionist. Outside of work, I usually play some video games—mostly MMOs and extraction shooters.
